output.headline: Midwest-active provider specialist with a same-sub-sector precedent and a 15.2x median multiple paid, in line with upper-quartile pricing.
output.differentiator: Joint-most active Midwest buyer on the priority list (6 deals, level with Welsh Carson), with a $173M median deal close to the target's size. [K:by_region, T:record]
output.why_them: Midwest provider specialist; pays near upper-quartile multiples

acquirer_overview.title: Provider-focused sponsor with 14 deals and a Midwest weighting
points: Financial sponsor with 14 deals from 2015 to 2023; 11 of 14 closed (79%). [T:record, K:closed_share]
Fund XIV is $11.5 billion; the mandate covers financial services and technology, healthcare, and growth business services. [P:1, P:2]
9 of 14 deals were in provider services, and 6 of the 14 were in the Midwest. [A:angles, K:by_region]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Provider specialist whose Midwest deals and platform-build record fit the target
points: Having bought in this or a neighbouring region is the strongest factor in its likelihood, though only a modest one. [S:geo_fit]
Platform Build in 5 of 14 deals and Margin Improvement in 6 of 14 suit a target with a 16.8% margin and 11.0% growth. [M:platform_build, M:margin_improvement, X:target]
1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors; it has no open platform in the sub-sector. [T:record, A:angles]

precedent_activity.title: A same-sub-sector Midwest deal and larger Midwest buyouts on record
points: Sterling Health Systems: $911M bolt-on, 2018, Midwest, 12.2x EBITDA, closed; its one deal in the target's own sub-sector. [D:MA-2018-0357]
Golden Orthodontics: $588M leveraged buyout, 2020, Midwest, 15.2x EBITDA, closed. [D:MA-2020-0276]
Zenith Specialty Care: $76M bolt-on, 2023, Midwest, 8.9x EBITDA, withdrawn. [D:MA-2023-0279]

valuation_context.title: Upper-quartile pricing is defensible and matches GTCR's own record
points: 70 comparable deals: 10.7x at the 25th percentile, 12.8x median, 15.3x at the 75th; the defensible percentile is the 75th. [V:comps]
The target's 16.8% margin beats the comparable median of 12.9%, supporting upper-quartile pricing; GTCR's median multiple paid is 15.2x. [V:comps]
At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M; IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target. Maximum price is $193M, or $216M on a 15.0x platform exit. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below GTCR's 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: The bid works only if GTCR underwrites a platform exit; the same-exit maximum is $193M. [V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: No open platform in the sub-sector
risk_flags.concern: GTCR has no open platform, and only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector. [A:angles, T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: It has 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors and a Platform Build motive in 5 of 14 deals. [T:record, M:platform_build]
risk_flags.reality: Nordic Capital, Welsh Carson and Advent International each have an open platform, so GTCR competes against better-placed sponsors.

risk_flags.title: Completion record
risk_flags.concern: Share of deals that closed is a slight factor against; 11 of 14 closed (79%). [S:close_rate_s, K:closed_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: 4 deals since 2022 show it is still active, and 12 of 14 were control deals. [K:recent, K:control_share]
risk_flags.reality: The 2023 Midwest bolt-on Zenith Specialty Care was withdrawn, so execution is not assured. [D:MA-2023-0279]

conviction.rationale: One deal in the target's own sub-sector and eight in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the case, but the lack of an open platform in the sub-sector holds conviction at Medium. [C:conviction]
